{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Deduplicate on patient_id by keeping the row with the highest sample_seq per patient_id, without filtering on biomarker_baseline
# This ensures all patients are counted, even if their only record has biomarker_baseline = -999
data_dedup = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Step 2: Count total number of unique patients
num_patients = len(data_dedup)
print(num_patients)"}
